source: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central. fdc.nal.usda.gov (CC0 1.0). Standard recipes of Egyptian dishes computed from it by nutrition/build_dishes.py, and single foods read from it by fdcId.
review: Figures estimated from a standard recipe, pending dietitian review. Allergens derived from standard ingredients, over-inclusive where the usual shop-bought or restaurant form carries one, not lab tested, pending dietitian review. An empty allergens list means none of the sixteen tokens was found in the standard ingredients.

householdReview.basis: Household sizes marked estimated are standard reference weights for the unit (a loaf, a skewer, a piece, a glass, a spoon) or multiples of the standard recipe's typical serving, not weighed samples; sizes marked usda are a USDA FoodData Central household weight for the food or a simple fraction or multiple of one. Pending dietitian review.
